_read_me: Every word in the dashboard's fire section. {name} is a real number counted at build time; a line whose number is absent or zero is dropped, so nothing brags about nothing. Entries with "placeholder": true are labelled on the page (friends, profile) or hidden (quotes) until you replace them and remove that flag. A quote must appear word for word in a real file in this workspace or it is dropped. Numbers: commits, decisions, files, projects, under_way, tests, heat, next_mark, mark_steps, plus preserved and live_total when those exist. {clock} works only in late_night. No em dashes.
